entities.summary: Albert Guardado Jr. is a retired boxer from the United States, who competed at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia. There he was defeated in the quarterfinals of the light flyweight division by Ukraine's eventual bronze medalist Oleg Kiryukhin.
